categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi Yuean Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, production, and sales of micron and nano metal powder new materials. Its main product lines include carbonyl iron powder, atomized alloy powder, soft magnetic powder, metal injection molding feedstock, and wave-absorbing materials. The company serves industries such as electronic components, 3C precision parts, automotive parts, power tools, microwave absorption and electromagnetic shielding, medical devices, and 3D printing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced powder metallurgy technologies including carbonyl process for carbonyl iron powder and atomization methods (gas, water, centrifugal) for alloy powders. It utilizes metal injection molding (MIM) technology for precision metal parts production, with proprietary innovations in ultra-fine powder preparation, surface modification, and recycling of rare earth iron slag. The company also integrates digital manufacturing systems such as MES and CRM for production and customer management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leaders in electronic components (e.g., Delta Electronics, Samsung Electro-Mechanics), 3C consumer electronics brands (e.g., Honor, VIVO, OPPO), automotive parts manufacturers (e.g., Porite, Indo-MIM), and industrial tool makers (e.g., Husqvarna, Hilti, TTI). The products are widely used in consumer electronics, automotive electronics, precision manufacturing, medical devices, and defense sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Ganzhou, Jiangxi Province, and subsidiaries in regions including Guangzhou and Ningxia. It has established a global sales network covering over 20 countries and regions including China, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, Europe, and Southeast Asia. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Germany serving the European market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangxi Yuean New Materials operates mainly upstream in the powder metallurgy supply chain, producing base metal powders and advanced powder materials. It supplies these powders both as raw materials and as processed products (e.g., soft magnetic powders, MIM feedstock) to downstream manufacturers in electronics, automotive, and industrial sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in micron and nano metal powder technologies, focusing on improving powder purity, particle size control, surface modification, and cost reduction through proprietary processes like cyclic thermal decomposition. It invests heavily in R&D with 31 ongoing projects targeting high-frequency soft magnetic materials, high-strength alloy powders, rare earth recycling, and environmentally friendly products. It also emphasizes digital transformation and ESG integration to enhance sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of metal powders and related processed materials. The company offers customized powder solutions and technical services to meet specific customer requirements. Sales channels include direct sales and distribution, with a focus on high-end consumer electronics, automotive, and industrial applications.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the micron and nano metal powder industry, competing with international giants like BASF, Sandvik Osprey, and Epson Atmix in the high-end market. It distinguishes itself by possessing dual core technologies (carbonyl and atomization) and a diversified product portfolio. It has achieved significant market penetration in China and is expanding globally, positioning itself as a competitive alternative to foreign suppliers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 418 million, a 13.38% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 70.29 million, a 12% decrease. Total assets reached RMB 907.7 million, growing 3.67%. The company maintains steady growth driven by expanding applications in consumer electronics and automotive sectors, supported by increased R&D investment accounting for 5.61% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangxi Yuean New Materials offers high-purity, ultra-fine, and highly spherical metal powders with superior soft magnetic properties and customizable surface treatments. Its products enable high-frequency, low-loss electronic components and precision metal parts with enhanced performance and environmental benefits. The company’s integrated product lines and rapid R&D responsiveness provide customers with one-stop, tailored solutions, supporting innovation in emerging fields like 5G, AI, and new energy vehicles.
